description: This file contains functions for checking the compatibility and performing upgrades on specific hardware platforms, particularly for board 'dlink,dir-685'. It defines functions to check the image and perform upgrades based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the current image is compatible with the hardware platform, specifically supporting 'dlink,dir-685'.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process for supported hardware, setting the partition and calling the default upgrade method.
